writtenTo: Timothy, Paul's young protégé in Ephesus
importantNotes: 'Don't let anyone look down on you because you are young' (4:12) — Paul encourages young leaders.
The qualifications for elders/overseers (ch. 3) remain the standard for church leadership.
'The love of money is a root of all kinds of evil' (6:10) — often misquoted as 'money is the root.'
1 Timothy, 2 Timothy, and Titus are called the 'Pastoral Epistles.'
'There is one God and one mediator between God and mankind, the man Christ Jesus' (2:5).

chapters.1: Warning against false teachers; Paul's testimony of God's grace; charge to Timothy.
chapters.2: Instructions for prayer and worship; pray for all people, including leaders.
chapters.3: Qualifications for overseers (elders) and deacons; the church as pillar of truth.
chapters.4: False teaching will come; train yourself in godliness; be an example to believers.
chapters.5: Instructions for widows, elders, and relationships within the church.
chapters.6: False teachers and the love of money; fight the good fight of faith; guard the deposit.
